findings.issue: AC10 duplicates AC3 (unknown job code, 404, no partial list). AC3 also requests a job by code, but the story names no such operation.
AC11 duplicates AC4: same caller, same rerun, same 403 MSG-P4-002 and no run row. TC-14 repeats TC-04.
AC12 repeats the 403 and 404 cases of AC4 and AC3, and uses the same non-existent job request.
The section 7 note still says 'The two criteria are the legacy ones' although new criteria were added.
Exception X2 still gives message None, but section 12.1 and section 14 give MSG-P1-011 for a running job.
Section 11 says the freshness answer is published in AD018-CON, contradicting step 8 and section 12.1 (owned by E1015-CON).
Section 15 gives the error and no access states, then says those same states are not specified.
MSG-P4-001 trigger is marked Not specified, but section 12.1 gives it: 401 no session.
Disposition note says section 14 rows have placeholder IDs, but they carry MSG-GEN-001, MSG-P1-011, MSG-P1-001 and MSG-GEN-006.
Marked Not applied although section 15 was edited, with placeholders for the states the sources do not give.
Note says BR3 and BR7 were already covered, but AC5, AC6, TC-08 and TC-09 are new in this edit.
Section 12.7 names job_catalog as reference data without the rwb-integration read path stated in sections 4 and 11.
